Definition: from the base of G5088; interest on money loaned (as a produce):--usury.
BiblicalUsage: Usury is interest on money lent, and both parables use it the same way. The master asks why the servant did not put his money to the bank or the exchangers, so that at his coming he might have received his own with usury.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe faithfulness, not banking, is the point: even the least the servant could have done was to put the money where it would grow.
